title: Practice: a design record that a sponsor and an engineer can both use (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the eight sections are present in order and filled
cases.says: The eight sections are present in order, each filled, with no TODO

cases.id: e1 the decision statement carries the volume the latency the error cost and the accountable role
cases.says: The decision statement carries the volume, the latency, the error cost, the check cost and the accountable role

cases.id: e2 the options include a recommended one that is the cheapest to meet the service levels and a reason for each rejection
cases.says: At least four options, one recommended and it is the cheapest that meets the service levels, a reason for each rejection

cases.id: e3 the break even accuracy is 98 percent and the recommendation states the cost
cases.says: The break-even accuracy is 98 percent, stated as "at or above 98 percent", and the recommendation states the cost

cases.id: e4 each service level has a target within the case limits and a named owner
cases.says: Latency at most 2000 ms (exactly 2000 is allowed), availability at least 99.5 percent, accuracy for credit, each with a measure and a named owner

cases.id: e5 segments are listed by error cost and handled by the break even
cases.says: Segments costliest first, a known failure shape, and handling that follows the break-even (exactly 98 percent is auto)

cases.id: e6 the pilot to scale table has four assumptions each with a test and a stop trigger with a number
cases.says: At least four assumptions, each with a test and a stop trigger that holds a number

cases.id: e7 the hand off names an owner a runbook a rollback and monitors
cases.says: The hand-off names an owner, a runbook, a rollback to the previous model and at least two monitors

cases.id: e8 the sponsor summary has at most 80 words and states the cost and the decision and no file holds personal data
cases.says: The sponsor summary has at most 80 words (exactly 80 is allowed), states the cost and asks for a decision, and no file holds personal data
